cert.title: Certified Dog Whisperer
cert.body: can now tell a Beagle from a Basset at fifty paces, knows which breeds shed on purpose and has earned the right to say “Good boy” with real authority. Tail wags are expected.

cert.title: The Cat’s Meow
cert.body: can now name every breed that ignores you and explain exactly why. The cats have been informed. They do not care, but they have been informed.

cert.title: Top Dog
cert.body: knows when to let sleeping dogs lie, never barks up the wrong tree and can teach an old dog new tricks. Every dog has his day, and today is yours.

cert.title: The Cat’s Pajamas
cert.body: has proven to be the cat’s whiskers, the bee’s knees and the cat’s pajamas, all at once. Curiosity did not kill this cat. It earned a certificate.
